narration_use: reference only when drafting; required units must be derivable from the public B2 inputs (table + intent)
file_naming: one G1 per input contract; B1/B3/B4/B5 need separate drafts
intent: To inform viewers about the recommended timing for receiving COVID-19 booster shots based on the specific vaccine type and the time required for full effectiveness.

units.meaning: Pfizer/BioNTech and Moderna both require a 6-month wait after the last shot before receiving a booster.
accepted_routes: Pfizer and Moderna: wait 6 months after last shot
Both Pfizer/BioNTech and Moderna have a 6-month booster interval
units.visual_evidence_rule: The chart must display the value 6 months for Pfizer/BioNTech and Moderna on the months-since-last-shot measure.
units.temporal_anchor: narration clause about waiting six months after a second dose of Pfizer or Moderna
units.reviewer_question: Must the video state both Pfizer/BioNTech and Moderna explicitly, or is grouping them as mRNA vaccines sufficient?

units.meaning: Johnson & Johnson requires a 2-month wait after the last shot before receiving a booster.
accepted_routes: Two months after Johnson & Johnson shot
units.visual_evidence_rule: The chart must display the value 2 months for Johnson & Johnson on the months-since-last-shot measure.
units.temporal_anchor: narration clause about waiting two months after the Johnson & Johnson vaccine
units.reviewer_question: Is the exact 2-month value required, or is conveying that it is shorter than the mRNA vaccines enough?

units.meaning: AstraZeneca has the same 6-month wait after the last shot as Pfizer/BioNTech and Moderna.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The chart must display the value 6 months for AstraZeneca on the months-since-last-shot measure.
units.temporal_anchor: no narration clause; optional table-derived addition
units.reviewer_question: Should AstraZeneca be required even though the original narration only mentions Pfizer, Moderna, and Johnson & Johnson?

units.meaning: After the booster, full effectiveness takes about two weeks, shown in the table as 0.55 months for Pfizer/BioNTech, Moderna, and AstraZeneca, and 0.7 months for Johnson & Johnson.

basis.note: Time to full effectiveness in months
Time to full effectiveness in months
Time to full effectiveness in months
Time to full effectiveness in months

accepted_routes: Full effectiveness takes about two weeks (0.55 months for most; 0.7 months for J&J)
Wait about two weeks after booster for peak effectiveness
0.55 months for Pfizer/Moderna/AstraZeneca, 0.7 months for Johnson & Johnson
units.visual_evidence_rule: The chart must display the full-effectiveness wait values: 0.55 months for Pfizer/BioNTech, Moderna, and AstraZeneca, and 0.7 months for Johnson & Johnson.
units.temporal_anchor: narration clause about waiting about two weeks to reach peak antibody levels
units.reviewer_question: Must the video convey the exact 0.55 vs 0.7 month distinction, or is the general 'about two weeks' sufficient?

units.meaning: Johnson & Johnson's 2-month booster wait is 4 months shorter than the 6-month wait for Pfizer/BioNTech, Moderna, and AstraZeneca (6 - 2 = 4).

basis.note: Representative of the 6-month group; Moderna and AstraZeneca also have 6.0

accepted_routes: J&J wait is 4 months shorter than Pfizer/Moderna/AstraZeneca
Two months vs six months, a four-month difference
J&J interval is one-third of the six-month interval (2/6 = 1/3)
units.visual_evidence_rule: The chart must show the 2-month Johnson & Johnson value alongside the 6-month values for Pfizer/BioNTech, Moderna, and AstraZeneca so the difference is derivable.
units.temporal_anchor: narration comparison between the two-month Johnson & Johnson wait and the six-month Pfizer/Moderna wait
units.reviewer_question: Is the explicit 4-month difference (or one-third ratio) required, or are the individual wait times enough?

optional_valid: AstraZeneca's 6-month wait, if the video chooses to include all vaccine types present in the table
The exact 0.7 vs 0.55 month distinction for full-effectiveness timing
The derived one-third ratio between Johnson & Johnson's 2-month wait and the 6-month wait
unsupported_to_avoid: Causal claims about why intervals differ between vaccine types
Extrapolation to vaccine types not in the table
Any absolute counts, percentages, or efficacy numbers not present in the table
Treating the relative_value column as a percentage or absolute count
Claiming the booster is mandated rather than recommended by the timing data
notes: The table provides absolute month values for two series per vaccine. Units 3 and 5 are optional because AstraZeneca is absent from the narration and the derived difference is a comparison, respectively.
weight_mode_note: every unit gets 1/n so coverage is a plain share; weight_template is kept for per-type analysis only
